headline: Indian IT services showed solid revenue growth with TCS and HCLTech posting strong earnings.
summary: TCS reported ₹73,188 cr revenue and a 24% operating margin, up 15.4% YoY. HCLTech posted ₹35,620 cr revenue, 3% QoQ growth and a 21% profit rise, driven by AI sales. Other majors have not released results, but exchange data shows double‑digit YoY revenue growth for Infosys, LTM, and Wipro. Overall sector momentum remains positive despite limited guidance from several peers.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: Both TCS and HCLTech highlighted AI revenue contributions, with HCLTech noting a 78% YoY jump in AI sales.

themes.title: Steady deal wins
themes.detail: TCS secured $9.6 bn of new contracts and HCLTech $3.258 bn, supporting revenue momentum.

leaders.why: Highest revenue and margin; strong deal wins and AI revenue crossing 10% of total.
Profit grew 21% YoY; AI sales are a key growth driver and guidance remains upbeat.

laggards.why: Results not yet released; no quarterly data to assess performance.
Only revenue guidance provided, with flat to modest sequential change.
